description: Activate when: user says 'our change initiative is stalling', 'people aren't adopting the new way', 'we launched the transformation but nothing changed', 'how do we overcome resistance to change', 'why do transformation efforts fail', or asks how to sequence or diagnose a planned organizational change. Do NOT activate when: the change is a small process improvement in a stable team (use PDCA instead), or the situation is a crisis requiring immediate command-and-control response. More: deciqai.com/c/kotter-change

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
